messages.snippet: All, The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday 9 May between 07:00 and 11:00
messages.subject: Planned DMS maintenance - Saturday 9 May, 07:00-11:00
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

The document management system will be unavailable this Saturday 9 May between 07:00 and 11:00 for a scheduled storage upgrade. Please ensure any documents you are working on are checked in before Friday close. Email will be unaffected.

Thanks,
IT Helpdesk
